hints.content: To find the image of $\triangle ABC$ under the dilation, we can dilate all of $\triangle ABC$'s vertices and connect them.

For example, point $\blueD C$ is $3$ units to the left of $P$ and $6$ units up, so its image is $\goldD{\dfrac13}\cdot3=1$ unit to the left and $\goldD{\dfrac13}\cdot 6=2$ units up from $P$.



[[☃ image 1]]

options.alt: Triangle A B C. Point B is six units to the right of point P and three units down, Point C is three units left from point P and up six units, and Point A is six units left of point P. There is a dashed line to highlight horizontally the three units left and vertically six units up from point P. There is also a dashed line to highlight horizontally one unit to the left and vertically two units up from point P.  There is another plotted point that is one unit left and two units up from Point P.

hints.content:
Let's do the same thing with the remaining vertices.

Since our scale factor is $\goldD{\dfrac13}$, every side length in $\triangle A'B'C'$ will be $\dfrac{1}{3}$ the length of the corresponding side in $\triangle ABC$.

Another way to think about it is that since our scale factor is closer to $0$ than to $1$, every point in the image will be closer to our center $P$ than to its corresponding point in the pre-image.

Connecting the vertices of the image, we get the following mapping:



[[☃ image 1]]

options.alt: Triangle A B C. Point B is six units to the right of point P and three units down, Point C is three units left from point P and up six units, and Point A is six units left of point P. There is another triangle graphed that is triangle A B C with a scale factor of one third from point P. The new triangle the Point B prime is two units to the right of point P and one unit down, Point C prime is one unit left from point P and up two units, and Point A prime is two units left of point P. The distance between C prime and B prime is approximately four point two units. The distance between C prime and A prime is approximately two point two units. The distance between A prime and B prime is four point one units.

question.content:
**Draw the image of $\triangle ABC$ under a dilation whose center is $P$ and scale factor is $\dfrac{1}{3}$.**
